name: server-watcher
title: Server health watcher
description: Inspect an allowlisted host and produce a concise exceptions-first operations brief.
prompt: Inspect the operator-configured remote host alias {host} using read-only commands only. Check failed services, disk and inode pressure, memory pressure, pending security updates and recent high-priority errors. Write {output} with measured values, exact command receipts, exceptions and recommended next actions. Do not restart, install, upgrade or edit anything.
checks: Every reported threshold includes its measured value.
The brief separates findings from recommendations.
